title: Oil prices jump over 4% as US and Iran trade attacks over Strait of Hormuz
summary: Brent crude rose to ~$79/barrel and WTI ~$74.51 after Iran declared Hormuz closed until further notice while the US Central Command disputed this; the strait carries ~20% of global oil transit. Asian stocks fell broadly on geopolitical risk.
why: 油价飙升推升通豀预期，可能迫使美联储更长时间维持鹰派立场，直接压制风险资产；港股能源板块（中石油等）短期受益，但整体市场承压。对期权策略而言，恐悅情绪推升VIX，sell put需收窄名义敌口。

title: 收评：泪指低开低走大跌2.06% 下跌个股超4600只
summary: 7月13日A股全面下跌，泪指跌2.06%报3913.79点，深成指跌3.48%，科创50跌逾3%，北评50大跌6%；存储芯片、商业航天、CPO概念股重挫，兆易创新等多只存储股跌停；中药板块和銀行板块相对活跃。
why: A股缩量大跌，美股科技高波动向A股传导加剧；持有A股科技/半导体仓位需警惕期权delta风险，sell put在科技赛道宜暂缓加仓。

title: 港股收评：恒指涨0.16% 科指跌0.96% PCB概念、半导体板块集体调整
summary: 7月13日港股涨跌分化，恒生指数微坧1.0%技。戀24213.72，恒生科技指数跌0.96%，国企指数涨0.33%；石油股因地缘局势受益，中石油涨超2%；建滔积层板跌超18%，半导体板块整体走弱。
why: 港股整体韧性优于A股，但科技指数偏弱；若持有恒科期权空头需留意delta变动，PCB/半导体相关持仓短线承压。

title: Bank Earnings Week: Goldman, JPMorgan, Citi, BofA, Morgan Stanley set to deliver a profit bonanza
summary: Five major US banks report Q2 2026 results: JPMorgan, Wells Fargo, Citigroup on July 14; Bank of America, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley on July 15. Goldman expected EPS ~$14.47 (+32% YoY) on record trading; JPMorgan consensus ~$5.44 (+10%). Options markets pricing 4-6% implied moves.
why: 銀行财报超预期将提振美股整体情绪；Goldman与Citi交易收入数据尤为关键。本周隐含波动率高气，持有美股期权者需管控仓位，避免gamma风险。

title: Stock market next week: Fed Chair Warsh testifies Tuesday, June CPI expected to drop to 3.8%
summary: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivers his first congressional testimony Tuesday while June CPI is expected at 3.8% annual rate (down from 4.2% in May). Fed holds at 3.50-3.75%; Goldman Sachs pushed next rate cut to 2027; futures now pricing higher odds of a hike than a cut.
why: Warsh鹰派立场叠加CPI数据是本周最大宏观催化剂；若CPI超预期或Warsh措词偏鹰，整体市场sell put策略应降低名义敌口；通豀回落则有利于成长股估值修复。

title: SK Hynix rises 13% in Nasdaq debut, raising $26.5B in largest-ever US listing by a foreign company
summary: SK Hynix (SKHY) closed at $168.01 on its July 10 Nasdaq debut (+13% above $149 IPO price), raising $26.5 billion - surpassing Alibaba's 2014 listing as the largest US IPO by a foreign company. Two 2x leveraged ETFs (SKUU bull, SKDD bear) began trading Monday July 13.
why: SK海力士美股上市为HBM存储赛道增加重要美股标的，与港股南方两倍做Multi存储相关产品形成联动；IPO成功强化AI存储需求叙事，利好整个存储板块。

title: EU Customs Duty Hits Temu & Shein Parcels: 5.9B imports now taxed with EUR3 flat fee from July 1
summary: From July 1, 2026, the EU abolished the EUR150 de minimis threshold and imposed a EUR3/parcel fee on all direct imports from third countries, affecting ~5.9 billion annual packages. Temu has slashed European ad spend by ~50% and is shifting to local EU warehousing to avoid per-item duties.
why: 欧盟新关税直接冲击PDD/Temu的欧洲出海低价模式，提高履约成本并压缩利润空间；对拼多多仓位需关注欧洲GMV增速放缓风险。

title: 黄仁勋：英伟达季度收入递近千亿美元，Rubin Ultra架构未延期
summary: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋携幂CFO与机构投资者路演，确认公司季度营收正遒近1000亿美元且增速仍在加快；明确否认Rubin Ultra延期至2028年的传言，称Rubin Ultra仍将按计划明年出货；Kyber机架调整属架构优化，非路线图变更。
why: 黄仁勋亲自辟谣延期且上调增速预期，直接提振NVDA估值支撑；对持有英伟达或AI芋片赛道仓位者极为正面，可适当提升sell put行权价或缩窄保护缓冲区。

title: Tesla launches Miami Robotaxi with fully driverless Model Y; Q2 deliveries 480,126 vehicles
summary: Tesla's Robotaxi expanded to Miami - the first unsupervised deployment outside Texas - with fully driverless Model Y vehicles requiring no safety monitor. Q2 2026 deliveries totaled 480,126 vehicles. Stock surged sharply on the combined catalysts.
why: 迈阿密Robotaxi无监督商业运营是特斯拉FSD变现叙事最强里程碑验证；若规模持续扩张有望推动估值重新定价。持有TSLA仓位可观察此催化剂是否推动分析师上调目标价。

title: 阿里巴巴6亿美元DOJ不起诉协议，布局礼来GLP-1减肥药中国市场
summary: 阿里巴巴与美国司法部达扐6亿美元不起诉协议，法律风险得到确定性边界；同时与礼来合作在中国推进GLP-1减肥药orforglipron，布局医疗健康赛道。Daiwa、Nomura下调目标价但维持买入评级。
why: DOJ协议落地明确法律风险上限，利于BABA/9988估值修复；GLP-1布局拓宽阿里云医疗AI应用场景，中长期利好；但合规整改期阿里云AI服务短期可能受扰。

title: 泡泡玛特：段永平持股升至7.65%；Labubu Hair Salon新系列遇谁罕见市场折价
summary: 亿万富翁段永平7月6日通过H&H International Investment将持股从6.85%增至7.65%（约1.02亿股），彰显长线信心；但Labubu Hair Salon新系列上市后多款SKU在二级市场低于官方售价，属品牌扩张以来罕见现象，显示消费者对新系列热情有所降温。
why: 大股东增持为9992.HK估值提供底部支撑，但Hair Salon折价表明新IP溢价已不如初期强势；对持仓者需权衡长线IP矩阵成长潜力与短期二级市场情绪分化风险，sell put行权价选择宜保守。

title: LABUBU Takes Over NYC: Pop Mart opens THE MONSTERS 10th Anniversary World Tour exhibition July 17
summary: Pop Mart is bringing an immersive THE MONSTERS 10th Anniversary World Tour exhibition to New York City, opening July 17 through August 31, as part of a global tour celebrating the Labubu IP's decade milestone.
why: Labubu纽约展览是Pop Mart全球化破圈的里程碑事件，高曝光有助于提升北美市场品牌认知和后续销售转化；对9992.HK是中长期出海IP建设的积极信号。

title: 小米发布Sky Nomad增程SUV系列，YU7累计交付逾25万辆，计划明年进军欧洲
summary: 小米7月9日发布增程电动SUV系列Sky Nomad（中文名“小米澎湃”），主打智能、多功能、大空间；截至6月底YU7自2025年6月上市以来已在中国累计交付倈25.8万辆。公司计划明年将产品线引入欧洲市场。
why: 新增程SUV拓宽小米汽车产品矩阵，覆盖更广用户群；YU7交付强劲显示电动车业务成长加速；欧洲出海计划若落地将是股价重大催化剂。1810.HK中长期逻辑持续强化。

title: SK Hynix reportedly starts Nvidia HBM4 shipments ahead of September ramp; HBM4E samples delivered
summary: SK Hynix began mass-production shipments of 12-layer HBM4 to Nvidia at end of June, ahead of a planned September ramp. SK Hynix also shipped HBM4E samples (16Gbps/pin, 20%+ power efficiency vs HBM4, 48GB capacity) to major customers on June 18.
why: HBM4量产出货英伟达是今年存储赛道最重要基本面事件；HBM4E样品送出意味着下一代存储产品路线图领先竞争对手，强化SK海力士AI存储核心地位，利好SKHY及南方两倍做多相关产品。

title: Circle wins OCC national trust bank approval, stock surges ~16%; GENIUS Act compliance deadline July 18
summary: Circle (CRCL) received US OCC approval to establish a national digital currency trust bank, enabling direct management of USDC reserves and institutional digital asset custody. Stock jumped ~16% intraday, settling at $65.80. The GENIUS Act one-year implementation period expires July 18, with major banks preparing rival stablecoins.
why: OCC牌照是Circle业务模式的重大升级，降低第三方托管依赖；但GENIUS Act落地后大行将发行自有稳定币，长期竞争格局趋紧。7月18日监管规则落地是下周催化剂，CRCL期权隐含波动率或上升。

title: Palantir doubles down on national security with Nvidia sovereign AI alliance; US Army NGC2 selects Foundry
summary: Palantir and Nvidia announced a partnership to deliver sovereign, air-gapped AI models (Nvidia Nemotron) for US federal agencies and critical infrastructure. The US Army's highest-priority modernization program (NGC2) selected Palantir Foundry as its core cloud data layer. PLTR rallied 14% ahead of July 4.
why: 军方NGC2 + Nvidia双重背书强化Palantir政府AI壁垒；政府合同落地降低短期收入风险，但PLTR估值仍高，sell put需选择充足保护距离。

title: Micron raises US investment to $250B through 2035; named Anthropic's exclusive HBM partner; HBM sold out through 2027
summary: Micron raised its planned US investment to $250 billion through 2035 (~$50B increase), broke ground on a $9.3B HBM fab in Japan, and became the exclusive HBM and storage co-development partner for Anthropic. HBM production is fully sold out through 2026 and 2027 presold. $22B+ in committed HBM customer agreements signed.
why: 美光HBM全面售磁至2027年、与Anthropic独家合作，是存储超级周期最强验证之一；对MU及两倍做多美光仓位极为正面。日本新厂破土意味着2028年之后产能扩张开始提速，长线逻辑坚实。

title: SanDisk surges ~800% YTD as S&P 500 top performer amid AI NAND shortage; BiCS10 sampling begins
summary: SanDisk (SNDK) has surged approximately 800% year-to-date as an AI-driven NAND flash shortage made it the S&P 500 top 2026 performer. On July 2, the company began sampling its 10th-gen BiCS10 1Tb TLC NAND with industry-leading density of 29Gb/mm2.
why: NAND供给紧缺叠加BiCS10高密度产品采样，短期基本面强劲；但800%+涨幅已包含大量预期，估值泡沫风险不可忽视；持有covered call可考虑适当锁利。

title: 腾训H1港股回购领跑近千亿港元；Q2 2026业绩定档月月8月12日披露
summary: 腾讯控股H1 2026在港股市场回购总金额遥遥领先，合计接近千亿港元；7月3日单日回购114.9万股，耗资5.01亿港元（价格区间约431-443港元）。Q2 2026财报确定于8月12日发布，43位分析师均维持买入评级。
why: 腾讯持续大规模回购为股价提供有力支撑，尤其在港股整体震荡期间有效托底；Q2业绩即将披露，8月12日是重要事件驱动窗口，当前sell put策略须权衡是否在该日期前缩窄敌口。

title: Intel advances 18A-P to risk production with 9% performance gain; July 23 Q2 earnings a critical test
summary: Intel announced its 18A-P process (9% higher performance at iso-power vs 18A) has entered risk production, meeting customer-communicated timelines. Profitable yields may not arrive until late 2026 or 2027. Intel's Q2 2026 earnings on July 23 will be a critical inflection point for foundry investor confidence.
why: 18A-P进入风险量产是英特尔代工业务的里程碑，但盈利性时间线仍压制INTC估值；7月23日财报是近期最关键催化剂，宜等财报确认后再考虑sell put介入加仓。

title: 国务院批复《中医药振兴发展“十五五”规划》，中药板块逆势活跃
summary: 7月13日国务院正式批复《中医药振兴发展“十五五”规划》，为中医药产业提供政策顶层支撑；A股中药板块当日逆势活跃，在市场整体大跌背景下成为少数亮点板块。銀行板块因多家銀行派发2025年度股息同步跟涨。
why: 政策利好中医药赛道，对主要持有科技消费赛道投资组合的边际影响有限；但如有港股中医药相关持仓，政策红利值得关注。
